fn render(expr: &Expr, minimum: u8, source: &Source<'_>) -> String {
    let wrap = |text: String, grouped: bool| if priority(expr) < minimum && !grouped { format!("({text})") } else { text };
    if let Some((text, grouped)) = source(expr) { return wrap(text, grouped); }
    let sub = |e| render(e, 0, source);
    let text = match expr {
        Expr::Name { name, .. } => name.clone(),
        Expr::Focal { .. } => ".".into(),
        Expr::Literal { value, .. } => match value {
            Literal::Str(s) => quote(s), Literal::Number(n) => n.clone(),
            Literal::Bool(b) => b.to_string(), Literal::Null => "null".into(),
        },
        Expr::Array { items, item_type, .. } => format!("[{}]{}", items.iter().map(sub).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", "), item_type.as_ref().map(|ty| format!(" of {}", crate::types::scalar_to_column(ty))).unwrap_or_default()),
        Expr::Object { fields, .. } => format!("{{ {} }}", object_fields(fields, source)),
        Expr::Unary { op, value, .. } => {
            let value = render(value, 7, source);
            if op == "not" { format!("not {value}") }
            else if value.starts_with('-') { format!("-({value})") } else { format!("-{value}") }
        }
        Expr::Binary { op, left, right, .. } => {
            let p = priority(expr);
            let (l, r) = if op == "??" { (p + 1, p) } else { (p, p + 1) };
            format!("{} {op} {}", render(left, l, source), render(right, r, source))
        }
        Expr::Member { base, name, .. } => match base.as_ref() {
            Expr::Focal { .. } => format!(".{name}"),
            other => format!("{}.{name}", render(other, 8, source)),
        },
        Expr::Call { name, args, .. } => format!("{name}({})", args.iter().enumerate().map(|(n, arg)| {
            let value = sub(arg);
            if n > 0 && matches!(name.as_str(), "day" | "hour" | "bucket") && matches!(arg, Expr::Literal { value: Literal::Number(_), .. }) && source(arg).is_none() { format!("{value}ms") }
            else { value }
        }).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", ")),
        Expr::Read(read) => read_with(read, source),
        Expr::Merge(merge) => format!("merge {}{}{} {} {} by {}{}:", merge.table, merge.matching.as_ref().map_or(String::new(), |q| format!(" matching {}", sub(q))), merge.cursor.as_ref().map_or(String::new(), |c| format!(" after {}", sub(c))), if merge.order == Order::Asc { "first" } else { "last" }, merge.take, merge.index, merge.filter.as_ref().map_or(String::new(), |p| format!(" where {}", sub(p)))),
        Expr::Exists { read, .. } => format!("exists {}", read_with(read, source)),
        Expr::Created { read, .. } => format!("created {}", read_with(read, source)),
        Expr::Assert { value, code, message, .. } => format!("{} ! else {code}{}", render(value, 8, source), message.as_deref().map(|m| format!(" {}", quote(m))).unwrap_or_default()),
        Expr::ShapeUse { base, name, .. } => format!("{} {name}", render(base, 8, source)),
        Expr::Shape { base, fields, .. } => format!("{} {{ {} }}", render(base, 8, source), shape_with(fields, source)),
        Expr::Walk { table, seed, column, depth, .. } => format!("walk {table}[{}] up .{column} depth {depth}", sub(seed)),
        Expr::If { then, condition, otherwise, .. } => format!("{} if {} else {}", render(then, 1, source), render(condition, 1, source), sub(otherwise)),
        Expr::Write { op, table, keys, fields, if_absent, condition, .. } => {
            let mut out = format!("{} {table}", op.word());
            // `delete row` / `update row { … }` keep their row-variable spelling.
            if *op != WriteOp::Insert && !keys.is_empty() { out.push_str(&format!("[{}]", keys.iter().map(|k| key_part(k, source)).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", "))); }
            if *op != WriteOp::Delete { out.push_str(&format!(" {{ {} }}", object_fields(fields, source))); }
            if *if_absent { out.push_str(" if absent"); }
            if let Some(condition) = condition { out.push_str(&format!(" if {}", sub(condition))); }
            out
        }
    };
    wrap(text, false)
}

        }
    }

                    "--seconds" => { let n: f64 = value.parse().map_err(|_| "invalid seconds")?; if !n.is_finite() || n <= 0.0 { return Err("--seconds must be finite and positive".into()); } seconds = Some(n); },
                    "--out" => out = Some(PathBuf::from(value)),

fn read_with(read: &ReadExpr, source: &Source<'_>) -> String {

codex
**NOT READY — three material issues.**

1. **[P1] Automatic `first 1` can truncate nullable unique populations.**  
   [repair/safe.rs:35](/home/ccheever/projects/sb4-b35-calls1/snapback4/crates/snapback4-lang/src/repair/safe.rs:35) trusts the diagnostic’s “at most one row” prose. Its producer checks uniqueness and pinned columns, but not nullability. With `slug: text <=40 ?`, `unique bySlug: slug`, and `return tags[slug = null] by .slug`, tied null rows are legal. The proposed one-row page compiles; compilation does not establish population preservation.  
   **Fix:** require structural proof of at-most-one, including nullability, before marking this mechanical. Otherwise retain advice. Section 9’s non-null guarantee currently overstates implementation.

2. **[P2] Matching refusal codes falsely establishes request identity.**  
   [proof-failure.ts:43](/home/ccheever/projects/sb4-b35-calls1/snapback4/packages/snapback4/src/proof-failure.ts:43) selects a historical observation solely by code and removes the uncertainty label whenever the assertion embeds that code. I reproduced a current `E_INPUT` assertion being attributed to an unrelated earlier operation and field.  
   **Fix:** label historical observations as uncertain context unless there is explicit request correlation. Preserve the assertion’s own refusal separately; code equality cannot establish operation, role, or field.

3. **[P2] Device admission refusals bypass proof observation.**  
   [local.ts:1310](/home/ccheever/projects/sb4-b35-calls1/snapback4/packages/snapback4/src/local.ts:1310) returns device refusals through `emitLocalFailure` or directly, neither of which records them. The new observation covers `failedAdmission`, but ordinary device prediction/admission failures take this other path. An assertion comparing only `write.state` consequently loses the refusal context.  
   **Fix:** observe these refusals at the admission boundary using the known operation and available role evidence, without arguments or rows. Section 9’s local-admission coverage claim needs correction.

The scoped upload fallback and quiet install changes retain their existing security checks. Review was read-only: no builds or edits; targeted checks used in-memory inputs and the existing binary.
